title: The Master Seating Chart  (El gran plano de mesas)

segments.t: Momentos antes de salir, en la tranquila habitación nueve, Arthur sostiene un pliego blanco de un metro cubierto de nombres caligrafiados en tinta azul. Hannah y Evelyn admiran su letra con una mezcla de asombro y cautela. Escúchalo todo primero.
Three hours of work, ladies — behold the Official Thirtieth Anniversary Courtyard Seating Plan!
My goodness, Arthur, your blue fountain pen lettering looks like a royal concert program!
Table One under the tree for our Room Eight mapmaker, Evelyn, and number ten!
Every neighbor from Linden Street sits beside someone who shares their favorite tea or hobby!
Let me copy those twenty-eight seat numbers into the heavy paper ledger right now, Arthur.
Copy it? Why hide a work of art inside a dusty pencil notebook, Hannah?
Fountain pen ink does run rather quickly if even two drops of water touch it, Arthur.
There is not a single raincloud in Portland today, Evelyn — pure golden sunshine!
Yes, sunshine plus strong Friday wind whistling down Linden Street right outside the gate!
I shall carry this poster firmly in both hands straight to the wooden easel outside.
At least slide your reading glasses onto your nose before you cross the threshold!
Watch and learn — nothing could possibly happen between Room Nine and table one!
Entremos otra vez en la habitación nueve para analizar el gran plano frase a frase.
Three hours of work, ladies — behold the Official Thirtieth Anniversary Courtyard Seating Plan!
'Tres horas de trabajo, señoras: ¡contemplen el Plano Oficial de Mesas del Patio para el Trigésimo Aniversario!'
My goodness, Arthur, your blue fountain pen lettering looks like a royal concert program!
'¡Madre mía, Arthur, tu letra con estilográfica azul parece el programa de un concierto real!'
Table One under the tree for our Room Eight mapmaker, Evelyn, and number ten!
'¡La mesa uno bajo el árbol para nuestra cartógrafa de la habitación ocho, Evelyn, y el número diez!'
Every neighbor from Linden Street sits beside someone who shares their favorite tea or hobby!
'¡Cada vecino de la calle Linden se sienta junto a alguien que comparte su té o su afición favoritos!'
Let me copy those twenty-eight seat numbers into the heavy paper ledger right now, Arthur.
'Déjame copiar ahora mismo esos veintiocho números de asiento en el libro de registro de papel grueso, Arthur.'
Copy it? Why hide a work of art inside a dusty pencil notebook, Hannah?
'¿Copiarlo? ¿Por qué esconder una obra de arte dentro de un polvoriento cuaderno a lápiz, Hannah?'
Fountain pen ink does run rather quickly if even two drops of water touch it, Arthur.
'La tinta de estilográfica sí que se corre bastante rápido con que la toquen dos gotas de agua, Arthur.'
There is not a single raincloud in Portland today, Evelyn — pure golden sunshine!
'Hoy no hay ni una sola nube de lluvia en Portland, Evelyn: ¡puro sol dorado!'
Yes, sunshine plus strong Friday wind whistling down Linden Street right outside the gate!
'¡Sí, sol y además un fuerte viento de viernes que baja silbando por la calle Linden, justo al otro lado del portón!'
I shall carry this poster firmly in both hands straight to the wooden easel outside.
'Llevaré este cartel bien sujeto con ambas manos directamente hasta el caballete de madera de fuera.'
At least slide your reading glasses onto your nose before you cross the threshold!
'¡Por lo menos bájate las gafas de leer a la nariz antes de cruzar el umbral!'
Watch and learn — nothing could possibly happen between Room Nine and table one!
'Mira y aprende: ¡no puede pasar absolutamente nada entre la habitación nueve y la mesa uno!'
Ahora, la escena completa una vez más, tal como suena de verdad.
Three hours of work, ladies — behold the Official Thirtieth Anniversary Courtyard Seating Plan!
My goodness, Arthur, your blue fountain pen lettering looks like a royal concert program!
Table One under the tree for our Room Eight mapmaker, Evelyn, and number ten!
Every neighbor from Linden Street sits beside someone who shares their favorite tea or hobby!
Let me copy those twenty-eight seat numbers into the heavy paper ledger right now, Arthur.
Copy it? Why hide a work of art inside a dusty pencil notebook, Hannah?
Fountain pen ink does run rather quickly if even two drops of water touch it, Arthur.
There is not a single raincloud in Portland today, Evelyn — pure golden sunshine!
Yes, sunshine plus strong Friday wind whistling down Linden Street right outside the gate!
I shall carry this poster firmly in both hands straight to the wooden easel outside.
At least slide your reading glasses onto your nose before you cross the threshold!
Watch and learn — nothing could possibly happen between Room Nine and table one!
Últimas palabras famosas, escritas en tinta azul: Arthur se lleva su enorme plano sin copia hacia una puerta azotada por el viento. ¡Hasta la próxima!
See you next time!
